verdict.rationale: Reflect documents a built-in AI palette (cmd/ctrl+j on highlighted text). It offers a dozen or so preset prompts such as 'list action-items' and 'list key takeaways', an open text field to ask anything, saved custom prompts, a GPT-4o or Claude 3.5 Sonnet model toggle, and the ability to chat with filtered notes to ask questions and extract information. The core of handing work to an in-product assistant is clearly delivered, but the evidence shows text transformation and Q&A rather than agentic actions. missing for 10: evidence of multi-step or agentic delegation where the assistant creates or edits notes and acts across the app on its own, independent or hands-on corroboration of the AI features.
